verdict.rationale: Extend has a dedicated SDKs docs page and a Python package (pip install extend-ai) referenced, plus full API coverage across parse/extract/split/classify/jobs implied by endpoint docs, suggesting SDKs wrap the full API. However, there's no explicit confirmation of a TypeScript SDK, no code samples showing typed usage or sensible defaults, and no independent/community corroboration of SDK quality or completeness. Missing for 10: explicit TypeScript SDK evidence, typed code examples demonstrating parse/extract/jobs coverage, and independent developer confirmation of SDK ergonomics/defaults.
